response: Simplification of pH data analysis in 24-h pharyngeal and oesophageal pH monitoring is feasible to some extent. Leaving out the period of intake of meals and beverages from the raw pH data can be a viable alternative, although it may not detect every instance of gastropharyngeal reflux. However, for scientific purposes or when in doubt, it is still necessary to manually review the computer-generated data to ensure accurate detection of all gastropharyngeal reflux events. This approach can help balance the need for efficient data analysis with the importance of accurate results.
